$comment: The MQTT topic contract, as data (#171).
There are three independent topic-builder implementations - TypeScript
here in packages/protocol, Swift in adapter-mac's Topics.swift, and
Kotlin in adapter-android's Topics.kt. Each had its own tests and
NOTHING asserted they agreed. They could drift apart silently, and the
only symptom would be a node going quiet on real hardware - which is
exactly the failure mode that produced #174, #175 and #182.
That risk peaks during the ADR 0015 migration, because all three move
at once. So all three test suites now assert against these strings.
A typo in one mirror fails that platform's tests instead of shipping.
Heartbeat deliberately has NO resource segment: ADR 0015 lists exactly
three topics that gain one, and liveness is per-node, not per-resource.

hid.$comment: ADR 0015's second resource type. No adapter implements it yet; included so the shape is pinned before one does.
